description: NaFeTiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-54°. There are three shorter (1.99 Å) and three longer (2.00 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-55°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.01 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-55°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.11 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-54°. There are five shorter (2.05 Å) and one longer (2.07 Å) Fe-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂Fe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂Ti₂Fe trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂TiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂TiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂TiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂Fe trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Fe atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and two equivalent Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂TiFe₂ square pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂Fe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, corners with three ONa₂Ti₂Fe trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂TiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂TiFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂TiFe₂ square pyramids, corners with three ONa₂Ti₂Fe trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂TiFe₂ square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂Ti₂Fe trigonal bipyramids.
